title: loop checkpoint writes must map workflow phases to valid workflow_step enum values
description: BETA FINDING. During loop drives the orchestrator checkpoints workflow_step into the session bundle; ad-hoc strings (e.g. "developer-tests", "in_review") are NOT in the bundle schema enum [idle,fetch,research,test,impl,review,update] and live-state.spec.js fails the release gate (test:all red) when they leak. Codify a mapping from loop/workflow phases to the valid enum values so checkpoints are always schema-valid, and document it so manual orchestrator checkpoints follow it too.
acceptance_criteria: A documented/exported mapping from drive-loop phases (test-writing, implementation, review, ticket-fetch, research, update) to the valid workflow_step enum [idle,fetch,research,test,impl,review,update].
The drive-loop / checkpoint path writes only enum-valid workflow_step values (no ad-hoc strings).
A regression lock asserts an invalid phase string is mapped/rejected rather than written verbatim (red-green proven).
orchestrator-routing skill documents the valid enum + the mapping for manual checkpoints; byte-identical parity copy.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED done — SUBSUMED by TASK-084 (reviewer-verified per-AC, cold re-verified): AC1 exported mapping = frozen LOOP_PHASES + SKILL.md table; AC2 enum-only writes = writeLoopCheckpoint validate-before-IO + on-disk schema-validity e2e; AC3 invalid-string regression lock = red-proven rejection specs at b2e1676; AC4 skill docs + byte-identical parity = verified via cmp/hash-object. Accepted design note: TASK-084 canonicalizes phase names to the enum itself and REJECTS unknown strings rather than translating ad-hoc aliases (test-writing/developer-tests etc.) — strictly stronger than this ticket asked for; the enum values are the canonical loop vocabulary. No separate implementation needed. Linked commits are TASK-084 range c07a995..bcb3596.
